privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how Go Cosmic handles personal data on this website and when you contact the studio by email.
privacy.legalNoticePrefix: For publisher and hosting details, see the

sections.title: Data controller
body: The data controller is Go Cosmic, represented by Matthieu Compérat. The studio can be contacted at support@gocosmic.dev for privacy requests.

sections.title: Data collected
body: The website does not provide an account area, checkout, server-side contact form, CAPTCHA, or advertising pixel. Messages are sent through mailto links and are processed by your email client and the recipient mailbox.
Technical data may be processed by the hosting provider for security and delivery logs. Vercel Analytics is loaded only after consent to measure page views.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
body: Email messages are processed to answer requests, prepare quotes, provide support, and keep evidence of exchanges. This processing is based on legitimate interest and, where applicable, pre-contractual steps requested by you.

Audience measurement is used to understand aggregate traffic and improve the website. Go Cosmic loads Vercel Analytics only after your consent. Security logs are processed for legitimate interest in protecting the service.

sections.title: Recipients and processors
body: Data may be accessed by Go Cosmic, the email service provider, the hosting provider, and Vercel for hosting and analytics. LinkedIn is an external website and may process data under its own policy after you click an outbound link.

sections.title: Retention periods
body: Email exchanges are kept only for the time needed to handle the request and follow-up, then archived or deleted according to legal, accounting, or dispute limitation needs. Audience consent is stored in your browser until you clear local storage or change browsers. Hosting logs are retained according to the provider configuration.

sections.title: International transfers
body: Some processors, including Vercel and email providers, may involve processing outside the European Economic Area.
Vercel frames these transfers using Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission. For questions about the applicable safeguards, contact support@gocosmic.dev.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability when applicable by writing to support@gocosmic.dev. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL: https://www.cnil.fr/.

sections.title: Cookies and audience measurement
body: No advertising cookies are intentionally loaded by Go Cosmic. Vercel Analytics is treated as a non-essential audience measurement tool on this site and is loaded only after your consent.
You can modify or withdraw your consent at any time using the preference management button displayed at the bottom of every page.
